ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large symmetrical white contiguous regions separated by a vertical black central pillar extending from the peduncle to the notch. Black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and distal tips, with tan-colored mottling clusters visible in the medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees; the notch depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across the continuous linear boundary. Notable jaggedness and small nicks are concentrated along the distal third of the trailing edge towards the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a slight sigmoid curve, beginning concave near the median notch and transitioning to convex towards the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered small, dark circular pixel clusters (approximately 5-10 pixels in diameter) distributed randomly across the white regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the upper-inner quadrant of the left lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Brownish-tan pixel gradients across the white surfaces; visible physical indentation (nick) on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan surface staining concentrated in the center of the white regions on both lobes, contrasting with the base white and black pigments.
